snapshot_note: Sage's publisher-wide page on preparing a manuscript. Sage says statements, keywords, reference style and sections vary by journal: SubmitReady reads the journal's own submission guidelines on every run.

csl_style.note: Depends on the journal (Sage Harvard, Sage Vancouver, APA and others).

requirements.rule: A 'Statements and Declarations' section at the end, after Acknowledgements, with every sub-heading; write 'Not applicable' where one does not apply
requirements.quote: Please include a section with the heading ‘Statements and Declarations’ at the end of your submitted article, after the Acknowledgements section (and Author Contributions section if applicable) including the relevant sub-headings listed below.
All journals require a declaration of conflicting interests from all authors so that a statement can be included in your article.

requirements.rule: Funding statement under its own heading, even with no funding
requirements.quote: All articles need to include a funding statement, under a separate heading, even if you did not receive funding.
You will need to publish a data availability statement with your article under this heading.

requirements.rule: Abstract with purpose, main findings and conclusions; trial registration at the end if any
requirements.quote: Your abstract should concisely state the purpose of the research, major findings, and conclusions.

requirements.rule: Separate title page, needed for double-anonymized journals
requirements.quote: You will also need to prepare a title page, this is essential for double-anonymized journals.

requirements.rule: Every in-text citation is in the reference list and the reverse, with identical spelling and year
requirements.quote: Every in-text citation must have a corresponding citation in the reference list and vice versa.

requirements.rule: Figures and tables made in Word go in the text; images made elsewhere (JPG, TIFF, EPS) go as separate files with a placeholder note in the text
requirements.quote: Figures and other files created outside Word (i.e. Excel, PowerPoint, JPG, TIFF and EPS) should be submitted separately.

requirements.rule: Raster figures at least 300 dpi; line art at least 800 dpi
requirements.quote: Line art should be supplied with a minimum resolution of 800 dpi.

requirements.rule: Tabular data as real tables, never as figures or screenshots
requirements.quote: If your figure includes a table, it should be a real text-based table instead of a figure.

requirements.rule: Check the journal's own guidelines for keywords, sections, reference style and anonymization
